description: paginate() slices one item too many
recorded: hand-authored replay in the api_response shape; regenerate from a real run with scripts/fixture-from-run.ts

content.text: The issue is about the limit on GET /items. Let me find where pagination happens.
paginate() uses `offset + limit + 1` as the slice end, so every page has one extra item. First a failing test.
Reproduced: 3 items for limit=2. The fix is the slice end.

input.summary: `paginate()` in src/utils.ts sliced to `offset + limit + 1`, so every page carried one extra item and pages overlapped when clients advanced `offset` by `limit`. The slice end is now `offset + limit`. Added tests/issue-1-pagination.test.ts covering the helper and the `/items?limit=` endpoint.
input.root_cause: Off-by-one in the slice end index of paginate(): Array.prototype.slice's end is exclusive, so adding 1 returned limit+1 items.
